$comment: FNO soundscape map — 21 §3, 22 (Dan's selection), audio/README, Dan's room-bed ruling. Files live in public/audio/soundscape-cc0/ under their original Freesound filenames; a missing file plays silence and is listed by npm run placeholders. Gains are linear multipliers on the beds/effects buses; regions are seconds into the file; all tunable without a rebuild. Regions were chosen by onset analysis of the files (docs/BUILD-HANDOFF-M00b.md), not by ear, and are provisional until Dan listens. One-shots are bound to UI events only, never to domain events; nothing here enters the ledger, the log, or the replay.

beds.note: Dan's ruling: 60–75 % below full scale by default. Loop region chosen for steady level (−25.3 dBFS ± 0.2 dB per second across the region) with a 0.3 s crossfade at the seam.
Sits under the room bed, never above it. Enabled only on the listed phases (preparation and post-flight).

one_shots.note: The cleanest isolated press in the file (onset 3.57 s, 2.6 s of silence before and 2.0 s after).
Toggle click region: the loudest clean switch click (onset 8.66 s, −23.6 dBFS peak, 10 ms decay) in the light-switch part of the file.
Detent region from the dimmer-slide part of the file (onset 22.19 s, −40.5 dBFS peak, 40 ms decay); boosted because it is quiet.
A single page flip (onset 19.2 s, −21.1 dBFS peak, 0.44 s of quiet before it).

one_shots.credit_required: Beep 8 count (loopable) by JonNicholas, freesound.org, CC BY 3.0
one_shots.note: ONE beep only — the first of the eight (the file's beat is 0.288 s); never loop.
